Result is a tuple with one pair? It shows "(('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C', 'CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC'),)". So precursors are two SMILES: first is a complex, second is "CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC". Need to format as list of lists: each inner list contains both strings.

Now need to apply to second SMILES from previous list: "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO". And third: "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO". Let's apply.
